description: Source code implementing file-based X.509 certificate and CRL loading functions for OpenSSL, including functions to load certificates and CRLs from files in PEM or ASN.1 formats, and internal control logic for file loading.

methods.name: X509_LOOKUP_file
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the static X509_LOOKUP_METHOD structure for file-based lookup.

methods.name: by_file_ctrl
methods.description: Control function handling file load commands for X509 lookup, loading default or specified certificate files.

methods.name: X509_load_cert_file
methods.description: Loads certificates from a specified file in PEM or ASN.1 format into the lookup context.

methods.name: X509_load_crl_file
methods.description: Loads CRLs from a specified file in PEM or ASN.1 format into the lookup context.

methods.name: X509_load_cert_crl_file
methods.description: Loads certificates and CRLs from a PEM file into the lookup context.
